name: runtime
description: The runtime linked into compiled Silver programs, built into out/runtime for silverc to link.
preGenerateCommands-windows: (if not exist "$PACKAGE_DIR..\out\runtime" mkdir "$PACKAGE_DIR..\out\runtime") & for %I in ("$DC") do (xcopy /d /y /q "%~dpI..\lib64\phobos64.lib" "$PACKAGE_DIR..\out\runtime" >nul && xcopy /d /y /q /i "%~dpI..\lib64\mingw" "$PACKAGE_DIR..\out\runtime\mingw" >nul)
